headlines.description: — By the time Franz Wagner finished outscoring Cleveland by himself in the third quarter, what had been a competitive game turned into another rout in this series between the Orlando Magic and Cavaliers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Franz Wagner scores 34, leads Magic to second straight rout of Cavaliers to tie series at 2-2

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Oklahoma City Thunder forward Jalen Williams was on his hands and knees after taking a hard shot to the eye on the opening possession of a pivotal playoff game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander, Thunder roll to 3-0 series lead with 106-85 win over the Pelicans

headlines.description: — For two days, the Boston Celtics lamented getting beaten on their home floor. And when they finally got to play again, they let out all the frustration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics lead wire-to-wire in Miami, roll past Heat 104-84 for 2-1 lead in East series

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Lakers finally cracked the Denver Nuggets' mastery of this rivalry and extended their playoff lives for at least another game.
headlines.shortLinkText: LeBron scores 30, and the Lakers avoid 1st-round elimination with a 119-108 win over champion Denver
